## `layout.md`

```markdown
# atlas: Claude Code context layout

| What | Where | Mechanism | Rationale |
|------|-------|-----------|-----------|
| Conventional commits, `make check` before PR, trunk-based dev | `/CLAUDE.md` | Root CLAUDE.md | Applies to every task in every service, so it is always loaded. |
| Repo map (api / web / pipeline, one line each) | `/CLAUDE.md` | Root CLAUDE.md | Routes Claude to the right service quickly; costs about 3 lines. |
| `api/gen/` is generated by `make proto`; never hand-edit | `/api/CLAUDE.md` | Subdirectory CLAUDE.md | Only relevant when working in api/, and it loads on demand when Claude touches files there. |
| Block edits to `api/gen/**` | `/.claude/settings.json` | PreToolUse hook on Edit/Write | Hand-edits are silently overwritten, so this needs deterministic enforcement, not just advice. The hook message points to `make proto`. |
| Unit tests are `npm run test:unit`; `npm test` launches real Playwright browsers | `/web/CLAUDE.md` | Subdirectory CLAUDE.md | web-only gotcha that Claude would otherwise get wrong. |
| Export `AIRFLOW_HOME=$PWD/pipeline/.airflow` before importing or testing DAGs | `/pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Subdirectory CLAUDE.md | pipeline-only gotcha; failures look like DAG bugs, not env bugs. |
| 20-step incident-response runbook | Org plugin marketplace → `incident-response` plugin → `skills/incident-response/` | Skill (distributed via plugin) | Repeated procedure used identically company-wide. A skill loads only when triggered, and a plugin gives one shared copy for all repos instead of copies in each. |
| Runbook step details | `skills/incident-response/references/steps.md` | Skill progressive disclosure | SKILL.md holds the trigger plus the step outline. Per-step detail loads only as Claude walks the user through it. |
| Live SQL against the analytics warehouse | `/.mcp.json` (project scope) | MCP server | Needs real-time external data access, which a skill or doc cannot provide. Project scope means analysts get it on clone. |
| Warehouse credentials | Env vars / secret manager, referenced from `.mcp.json` | MCP config | Keeps secrets out of git. Use a read-only warehouse role so Claude cannot mutate data. |
| Warehouse usage guidance (which schemas, cost limits) | MCP tool descriptions, not CLAUDE.md | MCP server design | The guidance stays with the tool and only costs tokens when the tool is in play. |
| Personal preferences (tone, editor habits) | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | User CLAUDE.md | Per-engineer, so it does not belong in the shared repo. |
| Optional: org-wide conventions across *all* repos | Managed policy CLAUDE.md | Enterprise managed settings | If commits, `make check`, and trunk-based dev are company policy, manage them centrally and remove them from the root file. |

## Deliberately excluded
- Language or framework basics (Go, React, Airflow): Claude already knows them.
- Directory trees and build details: Claude can discover them from the repo, and they would drift.
- Runbook text in CLAUDE.md: it would cost tokens on every session and be duplicated in every repo.
```

## `CLAUDE.md` (root)

```markdown
# atlas

Monorepo:
- `api/`: Go gRPC service
- `web/`: React/TypeScript frontend
- `pipeline/`: Python Airflow DAGs

Each service has its own CLAUDE.md with service-specific gotchas.

## Rules
- Commits use Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, ...).
- Run `make check` from the repo root and make sure it passes before opening any PR.
- Trunk-based development: use short-lived branches off `main` and merge quickly. Never create long-lived branches.
```

---

## Subdirectory files referenced above

**`api/CLAUDE.md`**
```markdown
`api/gen/` is generated by `make proto`. Never edit it by hand, because changes are silently overwritten. Edit the `.proto` sources and run `make proto` instead.
```

**`web/CLAUDE.md`**
```markdown
Run unit tests with `npm run test:unit`. Plain `npm test` launches real browsers via Playwright, so use it only when E2E tests are explicitly wanted.
```

**`pipeline/CLAUDE.md`**
```markdown
DAGs will not import unless `AIRFLOW_HOME` is set first:
`export AIRFLOW_HOME="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/pipeline/.airflow"`
Set it before any DAG import, test, or `airflow` CLI command.
```

**`.claude/settings.json`** (hook sketch)
```json
{
  "hooks": {
    "PreToolUse": [{
      "matcher": "Edit|Write|MultiEdit",
      "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": ".claude/hooks/block-api-gen.sh" }]
    }]
  }
}
```
The script should exit with code 2 when the target path matches `api/gen/`, with the message: "api/gen/ is generated; edit .proto files and run `make proto`."
